exposure: Expanded severe maternal morbidity (SMM) measure (including additional comorbidities and intensive care admissions)
Higher levels of perinatal care birthing facilities
cohort: The study included all New York State female residents, aged 10 to 55 years, who delivered a live infant in a New York acute care hospital between 2008 and 2013.
finding: The expanded New York severe maternal morbidity measure identified more cases (a 3% increase) than the CDC measure, with both estimates showing an increase over the study period, and several comorbidities and demographic factors were associated with increased risk.
